svg.title: Crowbar Circuit — Detailed Schematic
svg.text: F1 — 300A Fuse: interrupts current after crowbar fires
R9+C2 — RC Snubber: dv/dt protection for SCR
ZD2 — V_EB clamp: protects PNP driver
C3 — Noise filter: rejects HF on sensing divider
R1a/R1b, R3/R4 — Split resistors: voltage derating
C1+C4 — Supply decoupling: clean gate trigger pulse
SCR gate current: ~100mA from PNP driver
